destination.name: Merimbula
destination.tagline: Sapphire Coast lake town with national parks, beaches and heritage towns up and down the coast.
destination.description: Merimbula is a beachside town on Merimbula Lake in the far south of NSW, with 3,821 residents (over 11,500 with Pambula and Tura Beach) at the 2021 census. Wikivoyage says it draws visitors mainly from Victoria. Bournda and Mimosa Rocks national parks lie either side, Tathra has a heritage wharf, and Bega is the dairy town inland. Whale watching runs September to November.
whyVisit: Walk the Kangarutha track at Bournda
Explore Mimosa Rocks National Park headlands

goodToKnow.title: Parks differ in cost
goodToKnow.detail: Bournda charges $8 per vehicle in the brief, while Mimosa Rocks is listed as free.

goodToKnow.title: Tathra museum opens weekends
goodToKnow.detail: The museum beside the wharf is open Sat–Sun, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM; the wharf itself is open all hours.

goodToKnow.title: Buses are limited
goodToKnow.detail: Wikivoyage says local buses run only a few services Monday to Friday, so a car suits the spread-out parks and towns.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the warm months, with whale watching from September to November.
